# Scenario: ACME rate-limit → .downgradeCertMode (prod → test), then next cycle issues test cert.
#
# Cycle 1: Let's Encrypt prod directory is the local 429 stub; no ZeroSSL secondary.
# Cycle 2: point ACME at Pebble (ZeroSSL+EAB); effectiveMode=test from .downgradeCertMode.

acme-ratelimit-start

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: acme downgrade fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.ratelimit .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# --- Cycle 1: prod hits 429, schedule downgrade to test ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'rate limited domain=e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test'
stderr 'downgrade prod -> test'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
grep 'e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test' $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
grep 'mode: test' $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
! exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

acme-ratelimit-stop

# --- Cycle 2: same settings (prod) but override → test against Pebble ---
pebble-start
cp .apinfra.pebble .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

exec apinfra
stderr 'using downgrade domain=e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test requested=prod effective=test'
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test mode=test'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test/privkey.pem
exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test/.issued-mode
grep 'test' $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test/.issued-mode
# Downgrade file may still be present until until= expires; mode must remain test.
grep 'mode: test' $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

pebble-stop

-- .apinfra.ratelimit --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=letsencrypt
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://localhost:18080/directory
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://localhost:18080/directory

-- .apinfra.pebble --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=zerossl
certs.zerossl.AcmeKid=kid-1
certs.zerossl.AcmeHmac=zWNDZM6eQGHWpSRTPal5eIUYFTu7EajVIoguysqZ9wG44nMEtx3MUAsUDkMTQ12W
certs.zerossl.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-downgrade.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- .env --
